<function name="DoRightClick" parent="DTree" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called when the any node is right clicked. Called by <page>DTree_Node:DoRightClick</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="node" type="DTree_Node">The right clicked node.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="suppress" type="boolean"></ret>
	</rets>
</function>
